body: Wired Frog's Q (Loop Back: rewind own position/HP to ~3s ago via a new per-hero loopback ring buffer) and R (The Secret, simplified to reuse Ghost's intangible_ms). W and passive skipped, flagged. Bot heuristic is defensive since Frog deals no damage. 4 new tests, all green alongside full existing suite. Frog was the last hero from S170-32's audit that fits arena without new systems (allies, grid, multi-unit, cooking) -- flagged as a real decision point for future roster growth. Commit 43ff608. BACKLOG S170-33.
